_description: Enters long when price is below BB lower band AND below rolling VWAP by ≥0.5%. Exits at VWAP re-touch (TP) or ATR-based stop (SL). Captures short-term dips in trending or range-bound markets. Biased toward liquid hours with clear VWAP anchors.
_exit: TP = VWAP re-touch; SL = entry − 1.5×ATR(14); timeout = 60 min
_cost_model: fee_rate 0.1%/side + slippage 0.05%/side = 0.31% round-trip; avg TP depends on VWAP distance at entry (typically 0.5–1.5%)
